title: Kenyan Tropical Chicken Salad
community: Urban Kenya — the signature restaurant salad
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Tropical Chicken Salad — grilled spiced chicken over mixed greens with mango, avocado, papaya, macadamia nuts, and a passion fruit-lime vinaigrette. The signature hotel salad that puts Kenya's tropical produce on display.
longDesc: The tropical chicken salad is the signature salad of Kenya's finest resort and hotel restaurants — a generous, colourful bowl that showcases the extraordinary quality of Kenya's tropical produce while delivering a complete, balanced meal.
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts — grilled with paprika, garlic, and lemon
½ cup macadamia nuts — toasted and roughly chopped
steps: Grill chicken with spices. Rest and slice thinly.
Make vinaigrette: whisk passion fruit, lime, honey, and salt. Whisk in olive oil.
Top with mango, avocado, papaya, and red onion.
Lay sliced chicken across the salad.
chefTips: Toast macadamia nuts in a dry pan — they go from raw to burnt very quickly.
Dress generously — this salad needs the vinaigrette.
Arrange for visual impact — this is a restaurant-level presentation salad.
commonMistakes: Poor visual arrangement — this salad should be beautiful.
cookingScience: Macadamia nuts have the highest fat content of any nut (76%) — when toasted, this fat reaches temperatures well above the boiling point of water, creating rapid Maillard browning on the nut surface and producing rich, deeply toasted flavour compounds.
sustainabilityTips: Macadamia nuts are a significant Kenyan export crop — buying locally supports Kenyan farmers.
All tropical fruits and chicken locally sourced.
storage: Assemble and dress immediately before serving.
healthBenefits: Mango and papaya provide vitamins A and C.
Macadamia nuts provide healthy monounsaturated fats.
culturalNote: The tropical chicken salad is Kenya's culinary calling card at its finest — a salad that could only exist in a country with these specific ingredients, prepared with confidence and pride in what the Kenyan landscape produces.
